name: transform
note: css-text-3 §2.1 case mapping applied before measurement and paint (the computed value stays the keyword): uppercase widens, lowercase narrows, capitalize uppercases the first grapheme of each UAX-29 word — '"hello' becomes '"Hello' (punctuation skipped), 'foo_bar' becomes 'Foo_bar' (underscore joins the word), '123abc' is untouched (no uppercase mapping for a leading digit), and multi-grapheme clusters like 'ecole' capitalizing to 'Ecole' behave. The span widths pin the transformed measurement exactly.
